description: 504 distinct drand quicknet rounds (5 the repo cites plus 500 spread evenly over rounds 1..32200000), fetched from api.drand.sh. Each carries the published 48-byte compressed G1 signature and `randomness` (== sha256(signature), checked here), and `nobleAccepts`: @noble/curves 2.4.0 verified the signature against the quicknet key under DST BLS_SIG_BLS12381G1_XMD:SHA-256_SSWU_RO_NUL_ (message sha256(be64(round))). The Solidity verifier must accept every one.
